items.title: Paul Barbarin Interview, 1957-03-27
items.q: Oh, I think his name was Thompson, I think. Bob Thompson, I think it was it.

ctx.x: What was Longhead Bob's last name?
Oh, I think his name was Thompson, I think. Bob Thompson, I think it was it. You know, Bill, we haven't talked about the minstrel shows at all.
Do they come in with him anywhere, do you think? You mentioned Rabbit. Somebody told me once he'd been small or rainy, but you... Rabbit, yeah.
